item.title: PUSD board to vote on budget reallocations for Measure I, Measure I1 bond projects
item.description: Thanks to some significant savings realized in Pleasanton Unified School District’s Measure I1 and Measure I bond programs, the Board of Trustees will be poised to approve some budgeting reallocations during Thursday’s board meeting that would result in more money for new projects and additional enhancements to ongoing projects. The post PUSD board to vote on budget reallocations for Measure I, Measure I1 bond projects appeared first on Pleasanton Weekly.

item.title: Swalwell and competitors striving for headlines
item.description: “Swalwell has decided he has had enough of Congress and is surrendering his congressional seat to run for the open governor’s seat after Gov. Gavin Newsom is termed out. He has plenty of company in the campaign with 10 declared candidates.” The post Swalwell and competitors striving for headlines appeared first on Pleasanton Weekly.

item.title: San Jose mayor jumps into governor’s race
item.description: San Jose Mayor Matt Mahan on Thursday joined the race for California governor, putting to rest months of will-he-won’t-he speculation about his gubernatorial ambitions. The post San Jose mayor jumps into governor’s race appeared first on Pleasanton Weekly.

item.title: The road to revitalizing Pleasanton’s Main Street
item.description: Strolling through downtown Pleasanton, it’s hard for many to look past the vacant storefronts — seemingly one a block, if not more; some deserted for years, while others emptied only recently. But the PDA says plenty is going on behind the scenes in those units and elsewhere in and around Main Street to set the stage for an exciting, vibrant 2026 downtown. The post The road to revitalizing Pleasanton’s Main Street appeared first on Pleasanton Weekly.

item.description: Furniture and home goods giant IKEA has revealed its plans to open a new-concept store at the Pleasanton Square Shopping Center this summer. The post IKEA plans to open new-concept store in Pleasanton appeared first on Pleasanton Weekly.
